Grepped the whole file: no jieba import, no CJK-aware tokenizer an

title: The byte formatter mislabels binary sizes with decimal SI unit names, and never localises its decimal point
what_i_did: Read _fmtBytes (src/static/app-core.js:990-994) and compared its output across en/fr/de/ru/ar on the Library storage panel.
what_i_saw: _fmtBytes divides by 1024 (binary) at each step but labels the result 'KB'/'MB'/'GB'/'TB' — the SI DECIMAL prefixes (which by definition mean ×1000) rather than the correct binary prefixes KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB.
